snippet.title: Super Boy Allan - Famicom (1987)
snippet.description:
A Famicom Disk System game that is supposed to educate? I'm a bit lost without looking at the manual because it doesn't make a lot of sense to me what you're supposed to do to make things work. It wouldn't be hard to figure out with that manual, so if you're interested...

Visually, this seems like intentional or sanctioned theft of Zelda? There's also some Sunsoft music in here that sounds awfully familiar. I'm sure there's some Blaster Master in here, but this came first.
